text.method:
colour of the first visible

with 20+ characters outside header/nav, else the first div/span with 20+ characters of its own text outside headings, links and header/nav

bodyFamily.method:
font-family of the first visible

with 20+ characters outside header/nav, else the first div/span with 20+ characters of its own text outside headings, links and header/nav

buttonFill.method: visible link/button 60-500px wide, 28-90px tall, 2-40 characters, with a fill unlike the surface behind it, outside header/nav when any is; among those, coloured fills (OKLCH chroma >= 0.04) before greys, then the one standing off its nearest opaque ancestor most (WCAG contrast): background-color ("GET STARTED FREE")

buttonText.method: visible link/button 60-500px wide, 28-90px tall, 2-40 characters, with a fill unlike the surface behind it, outside header/nav when any is; among those, coloured fills (OKLCH chroma >= 0.04) before greys, then the one standing off its nearest opaque ancestor most (WCAG contrast): color of the element holding its label text

buttonRadius.method: visible link/button 60-500px wide, 28-90px tall, 2-40 characters, with a fill unlike the surface behind it, outside header/nav when any is; among those, coloured fills (OKLCH chroma >= 0.04) before greys, then the one standing off its nearest opaque ancestor most (WCAG contrast): border-top-left-radius

buttonFamily.method: visible link/button 60-500px wide, 28-90px tall, 2-40 characters, with a fill unlike the surface behind it, outside header/nav when any is; among those, coloured fills (OKLCH chroma >= 0.04) before greys, then the one standing off its nearest opaque ancestor most (WCAG contrast): font-family (monospace by equal glyph widths)

buttonCase.method: visible link/button 60-500px wide, 28-90px tall, 2-40 characters, with a fill unlike the surface behind it, outside header/nav when any is; among those, coloured fills (OKLCH chroma >= 0.04) before greys, then the one standing off its nearest opaque ancestor most (WCAG contrast): text-transform, or the label written in capitals

buttonTracking.method: visible link/button 60-500px wide, 28-90px tall, 2-40 characters, with a fill unlike the surface behind it, outside header/nav when any is; among those, coloured fills (OKLCH chroma >= 0.04) before greys, then the one standing off its nearest opaque ancestor most (WCAG contrast): letter-spacing / font-size

panelRadius.method: median border-top-left-radius of 1 visible bordered or filled boxes (4000px²+, under 90% of the width, not buttons)

labelMono.method: 17 visible elements with 2-30 characters of their own text at 14px or smaller: 17 monospace by equal glyph widths (share >= 0.3)

labelCase.method: 17 visible elements with 2-30 characters of their own text at 14px or smaller: 13 uppercase (share >= 0.3)

labelTracking.method: 17 visible elements with 2-30 characters of their own text at 14px or smaller: median letter-spacing / font-size of the uppercase ones

accent.method: most chromatic colour (OKLCH chroma 0.195, greys under 0.04 excluded) among the primary call-to-action fill, visible link text, h1 descendants in another colour and inline-svg logo paint
